trajectory_summary: The call opens cold and stays on defense: the customer front-loads a low-bill-plus-prior-quote objection before verify even starts, and the rep never regains initiative, mirroring her objection back and letting her self-disqualify off her own low bill. Energy leaks steadily from 00:21 to the polite opt-out at 01:39 with no flip, no probe follow-through, and no appointment attempt.
outcome_dispute: v1 tag is unknown; this should be read as no_appointment — the rep never asked for a time or offered next steps, and the call ends with the customer requesting removal from the call list.

observed_outcome.quote: Okay. I can take you off the list. You have a great day.
observed_outcome.reasoning: Rep never attempts to set a time or offer a next step; call ends with rep agreeing to remove her from the call list.

bill_anchor_audit.bill_quote: it doesn't get any higher than $60
bill_anchor_audit.reasoning: Bill was captured at 01:16 ('it doesn't get any higher than $60') but the rep never flipped it into a reason to act; the flip should have landed at 01:04 or 01:21 instead of restating her objection or a generic no-upfront-cost line.

bill_document_audit.reasoning: The rep did not request the utility bill or ask the customer to send a bill during the call.

interest_reason_audit.reason_quote: my energy bills are really, really low
interest_reason_audit.reasoning: Customer stated her interest reason ('my energy bills are really, really low' as evidence against solar, and separately her values-based affinity for solar at 01:46) but the rep never reinforced either — the low-bill line was used as a counter, not leveraged, and the green-building affinity was left completely unaddressed.
